environment: Linux Chromium real IndexedDB and BroadcastChannel; anonymous explicit storage account scope, no real Auth/HTTP or Apple device verification

checks.name: composition opt-in requires explicitly connected, current material; no implicit binding or upload
pending upload is immutable after local edits and reload; exact receipt advances only its captured revision
same remote revision validates its acknowledged head even after local edits and never overwrites them
remote source revision cannot lead local material or regress an accepted dependency
two tabs serialize competing remote applies and reject same revision with different payloads
racing local edits become a conflict; stale resolution cannot discard newly saved text
choosing remote atomically preserves unselected composition and exact material as a restorable backup
choosing local preserves the remote composition and prepares a fresh CAS operation
aborted final metadata write rolls back composition, head, and recovery together
pausing composition rejects late acknowledgement and apply while preserving its outbox
foreign account cannot inspect composition state or recovery snapshots from the same database
corrupted revision metadata fails closed without replacing local composition
browser reports no unexpected errors or external requests
